subject.title: [Bug]: CLI relay exits silently with code 1 when session lane is blocked — no timeout or busy error surfaced

question: Should Gateway-backed CLI agent dispatch return a terminal `LANE_WAIT_EXCEEDED` busy result for blocked same-session lanes, and what exit-code contract should that result use?
rationale: Current main only exposes the facts as diagnostics; the open candidate changes the user-visible CLI contract, so maintainers need to confirm that behavior before the issue can close.

options.title: Land a lane-busy result
options.body: Adopt the linked PR direction, with any maintainer-requested exit-code or wording adjustment, so operators get deterministic stderr/JSON output.

options.title: Keep queued execution semantics
options.body: Reject terminal busy rejection and instead surface a clearer timeout/failure message while preserving the existing wait-until-run behavior.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that gateway logs are sufficient and leave CLI callers to handle the generic failure path.

recommendation.title: Land a lane-busy result
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR direction, with any maintainer-requested exit-code or wording adjustment, so operators get deterministic stderr/JSON output.
